history.text: Finance at Altamira says the monthly FX statement is off by a few cents on JPY and KWD accounts. Figure out what's wrong in the rounding. Don't change prod data.

Reproduced it. We round every currency to 2 decimals in `convertAmount`, at line 112 of `src/fx/convert.ts`. JPY has 0 minor units and KWD has 3. For KWD we lose a fils on each line and that accumulates to about 0.4 KWD a month on the busy accounts. For JPY we store fractional yen which then gets truncated in the statement renderer.

The fix is to read minor units from the currency table. I need to know how you want old statements treated: restate them or leave them and fix forward.
fix forward for now. no restating until I talk to Altamira's controller. Marek owns the statement renderer, keep him in the loop
Fix forward only, no restating. I will write the renderer questions down for Marek and not edit the renderer myself. Working on the minor unit change now.
Add CSV export to the invoices page in the customer portal. Behind a flag. Max 10000 rows.
Started. Export button added behind `portal.invoiceCsvExport`. Streaming the CSV from the existing list endpoint with a 10000 row cap. Running the test suite now.
